newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P puts Foster's on negative watch.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P puts Foster's on negative watch.

text.p: Ratings agency Standard and Poors Corp said on Thursday it had affirmed Foster's Brewing Group Ltd's FBG AX BBB-plus long term and A-2 short term ratings, but had revised its outlook to negative to stable after Foster's announcement of a capital reconstruction.
"The outlook revision reflects the company's heightened financial risk, following the debt-funded A$625 million buy-back of its shares from Ashahi Breweries," Standard and Poor's (S&P) said.
"Consequently, Foster's prudential ratios have weakened, limiting the company's ability to undertake further expansion within the rating assigned," S&P said.

Foster's ratings were underpinned by its strong Australian market position and the satisfactory performance of its Canadian operations, S&P said. But it now had limited scope to fund large debt-funded investments, it said.
"Foster's more aggressive financial position, following the share buy-back, has caused financial ratios to move to the upper limit for the rating category," S&P said.
Pre-tax earnings to interest cover was expected to remain in line with Foster's minimum target of 3.0 times in 1997/98, down from 4.1 times in the first half of 1996/97, S&P said.

But leverage or net debt to net capitalisation was likely to increase to 40 percent to 45 percent in 1997/98 from 28 percent in the first half of 1996/97, above Foster's target level of about 33 percent.
"As well, funds from operations to total debt is expected to fall to about 20 percent in fiscal 1998 from 33 percent in interim 1997," S&P said.
"Until debt is reduced to more moderate levels, and financial ratios move back to target levels, the company's credit quality will remain vulnerable to further debt-funded instruments."

Earlier on Thursday Foster's announced buyback of 13.0 percent of Foster's shares from Asahi Breweries Ltd's and the sale and placement of the 36.5 percent of Foster's shares owned by the Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP).
